question: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Limited established as a fully owned subsidiary of the Reserve bank in the year ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Limited (BRBNMPL)** was established in **1995** as a fully owned subsidiary of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.

• The primary objective of BRBNMPL is to cater to the increasing demand for currency notes in India and ensure smooth circulation of banknotes in the economy.

• BRBNMPL operates with two highly secure printing presses located at **Mysuru, Karnataka**, and **Salboni, West Bengal**.

• This establishment allowed the Reserve Bank of India to reduce dependence on external sources for currency printing, enhancing efficiency and security.
